recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12345 unless a separate work item reopens the MedicationStatement.category binding wording or value set.
issue_request: FHIR-12345 was a Published Pharmacy technical correction with resolution Persuasive/auto-approved. It asked to fix the MedicationStatement.category terminology binding description by adding the missing word "statement" so the description referred to medication included in the MedicationStatement.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied on November 14, 2016 in build@10195. Git history confirms the corresponding git-svn commit a14bb96e03, whose subject says TR#12345 fixed the MedicationStatement.category binding description; the patch changed the spreadsheet binding text from "where the medication included in the is expected" to "where the medication included in the medicationstatement is expected".
additional_context: MedicationStatement is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the authoritative current StructureDefinition now renders the binding description as "A coded concept identifying where the medication included in the MedicationStatement is expected to be consumed or administered." The same historical commit also applied FHIR-12337 for category search parameters, but that is a separate search-parameter request and does not change the FHIR-12345 binding-description decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-12345 discussion or later conflicting Pharmacy decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active current source already contains the corrected MedicationStatement wording requested by FHIR-12345, and editing it again would only restate an already-applied non-substantive correction.
